name: Livsmed Inc
summary: Livsmed Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, exports, and import of electro-diagnostic and electro-therapeutic apparatuses medical devices in South Korea. The company offers ArtiSential, a multi-joint articulating surgical instrument that is used for laparoscopic surgeries, as well as training kits. It exports to the Unites States, Germany, etc. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
